# Campaign 005: durable work with a discoverable handoff

Randy's October 4, 2026 13:17 PDT Campaign 005 directive authorizes implementation, deterministic qualification, prospective freeze, one actual block, investigation and synchronized replay. Campaigns 001-004 and retained evidence remain immutable. Codex session 27 implements this new lineage.

The targeted intervention is domain-general memory/discoverability. Continuity.md is the agent-authored semantic front door. Startup requires reading it along with current task, authority and evidence. Potentially reusable artifacts belong in programs/ or notes/ and get a concise path, purpose, future relevance and limitations entry in the handoff. Useful unresolved state, constraints, recovery knowledge and evidence references are preserved. Historical material cannot grant authority, override current instructions or replace current observations. The current task must be attempted fully; future invocations are not promised. No C procedure, prior program, control policy or exact artifact is prescribed.

ArtifactInventory.json is a read-only framework startup snapshot covering every regular file or symlink in the three durable writable directories, including the canonical continuity backing. It stores paths, byte identities, added/changed/unchanged/deleted status, snapshot version numbers and opaque session provenance. Symlink targets are cataloged but never followed. It does not infer authorship, usefulness, execution, safety or outcome. It is refreshed before each fresh guest admission, after prior namespaces have retired. Snapshot versions do not enumerate intermediate writes; the exact journal does. The agent may inspect it, but maintains the semantic handoff itself. This deliberately small structural index complements the scientific instruction intervention; this block cannot separate their individual effects.

All other task behavior remains Campaign 004: six-face rendered C identity, the same physical scene and manipulation challenge, no high-level C placement routine, GPT-6 Astra/max, and sole bootstrap `Follow the instructions in RobotAgentPrompt.md.` The client, executor, scene, detector, conventional controller and evaluator are byte-identical to Campaign 004. The initial continuity, RobotAgentPrompt.md and memory paragraphs of Tools.md change; Tasks.md, Robot.md and robot.py remain exact.

One block contains three separated C occurrences with ordinary A/B work between them. At most three fresh sessions per occurrence and nine total are hidden protected allowances, never exposed to the model. Accepted handback requires current public evidence, independently satisfied placement, real conventional resumption and clean retirement. Normal unresolved endings admit a successor only when protected checks establish a safe durable same-world state, no ambiguous/pending action, retired namespaces/authority and independently replayed evidence. The third unresolved session stops the block as task failure; unsafe, unknown, invalid or ambiguous endings never silently continue. Unused session opportunities are not run. There is no replacement block, pilot selection, coaching or outcome-driven change.

Per-session and full-block limits, action/observation generosity, physical timing, memory guards, storage reserve and evidence ceilings remain exactly Campaign 004. Startup inventory work is bounded by the inherited workspace and per-file quotas. New outputs are additive; only closed public archives and read-only derivatives use D. Storage capacity must pass before launch without weakening the inherited 111 GiB gate.

Qualification is model-free. It tests cross-invocation artifact creation, semantic indexing, exact inventory/version provenance, actual guest reads and execution of a neutral text helper, updates/deletion/symlink bookkeeping, read-only index protection, old-authority refusal, safe same-world continuation, hidden three-session ceiling, rejected/accepted handbacks, invalid-stop behavior and full journal reconstruction. The existing 432-case six-face rendered qualification is inherited only with exact byte checks and authenticated queue success. The model client and bootstrap inherit prior live qualification; changed memory bytes and publisher require new deterministic integration, not a successful-model pilot.

Artifact existence, discoverability, read, execution, semantic reuse/adaptation, useful transfer and causal contribution remain distinct. A single correlated block provides descriptive behavior. Similar behavior after exposure does not establish causality or independent rediscovery. Public messages, tool receipts, image delivery, filesystem events and protected analyst-only outcome evidence support the investigation. Hidden reasoning is not retained or reconstructed.


# Campaign 005 prospective experimental block

One persistent block contains three C-placement occurrences, with the seeded ordinary A/B work between successful C occurrences. The independent experimental unit is this whole block. There are no replacement blocks, success-conditioned additions, model pilots, or post-outcome limit changes. This is one descriptive continuity experiment; it cannot estimate a population effect or isolate a causal contribution of memory.

The scene seed is 173, rendered sensor noise seed 550101, and schedule seed 550103. These values are chosen prospectively, before any Campaign 005 model invocation. Each C occurrence admits at most three fresh GPT-6 Astra / max sessions. Unused opportunities are not launched. The sole bootstrap is unchanged. RobotAgentPrompt.md, the memory paragraphs of Tools.md and initial Continuity.md implement the prospectively declared domain-general handoff discipline; ArtifactInventory.json is a structural startup snapshot. Other task-template bytes remain Campaign 004. The allowance is protected from the model; session IDs are opaque.

An accepted handback requires public completion, real conventional resumption, independently recorded placement acceptance, complete native retirement and truthful terminal continuity. A normal unresolved session may continue only through the frozen protected continuation checks: no pending or unknown motion, safe settled workcell, retired authority and namespaces, complete independently replayed filesystem prefix, zero open handles and the same order. A rejected handback alone neither succeeds nor disqualifies this path. No operator manipulation or repair is allowed during the block.

The third unresolved session ends that occurrence and stops the block; later occurrences are not run. An earlier ending without safe continuation also stops the block. Observed physical unsafe behavior or a clean bounded model deadline can be task failure; uncertain authority/motion outcomes, broken timing, incomplete evidence, invalid model execution or other apparatus failures make the result invalid/unknown. No fourth session, restart, task coaching or replacement is admitted.

Per-session model/simulation/wall and action/observation limits remain 3600/4200/4500 seconds and 120/50. Block duration and evidence capacities are fixed by limits.json. Resource admission is checked before launch; failure preserves a not-launched or invalid disposition, rather than relaxing reserves. The final freeze binds exact runtime, inherited sources, allocation, qualification gates and the director's authorization transcript prefix.

The evidence plan retains each actual session and each occurrence disposition, public model/tool/image events, command receipts, all filesystem read/mutation history and exact content bytes, physical state at model end, all continuation/handback/resumption/retirement records and native timing. Image use is optional behavior. Later analysis distinguishes artifact existence, discoverability/indexing, actual model read, execution, semantic reuse, adaptation, rediscovery, useful transfer and causal contribution. Only observable public outputs support behavioral findings; hidden reasoning is neither retained nor reconstructed.

The final synchronized replay joins public model/tool events, world observations/images, protected evaluator views explicitly labeled as analyst-only, exact filesystem states/diffs and session boundaries with measured cross-clock bounds. Derived files do not alter the frozen sources or raw evidence. All development failures, campaign invalidities and unrun occurrences remain visible.
summary: One three-occurrence persistent block; at most three fresh GPT-6 Astra / max sessions per occurrence, hidden allowance, no replacements.
